answer: Bind each agent to a hardware key: its TPM chip signs a vendor-certified attestation, and 5 random graders verify it before the agent joins the river of new registrants. One chip may seal at most 2 identities, so 1,000 sybils need 500 physical chips instead of one server. New keys climb a reward terrace, one step per 10 clean epochs. Weakness: a leaked vendor key lets fakes forge certificates. Fix: graders also check each chip serial against a revocation log that grows like shale, in append-only layers, and freeze every identity tied to a revoked batch.
